title: German Hazelnut Wrap
description: A delicious German-inspired wrap filled with roasted hazelnuts and savory spices.
instructions: Roast the hazelnuts in the oven for 5-7 minutes, or until fragrant and lightly browned.
In a small bowl, mix together the cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
In a large bowl, combine the roasted hazelnuts, crumbled feta cheese, chopped onion, and spice mixture.
Drizzle the lemon juice and olive oil over the top and toss to combine.
Warm the whole wheat wrap in the oven for 2-3 minutes, or until pliable.
Spoon the hazelnut mixture onto the center of the wrap and fold the bottom edge up over the filling.
Fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
